_about: 50 articles drawn at random (seeded, stratified by country group) from the live database on 2026-11-11. Summaries are cut to about 220 characters. 'entities' lists the people, places, organizations and groups in the text, in the form the cleanup produces (titles removed, aliases applied), with the topic keywords Iran, Iranian and Tehran left out. A list inside the list means any of those forms is correct. 'optional' names are neither required nor counted as errors. 'tone' is the reader's call: does the text report or threaten military or hostile action (escalation), negotiation or mediation (diplomacy), both, or neither. One annotator, so treat the scores as indicative.
